senses.gloss: f. (ὁμολογία) [agreement, admission] receipt, discharge. [This meaning of ὁμολογία as receipt cannot be proven from Greek literature; cmp. however, Sm. Dict. Ant. s. v. Acceptilatio.] Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ bot., explaining שוברים (v. שׁוֹבֵר, receipt) אימולוגים (corr. acc., De Lara אוֹמוֹלוֹגִין pl. m. fr. ὁμόλογον).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:9:2">Y. Keth. IX, end, 33ᶜ</cite> <he>ולית רב או׳</he> (= <he>ולית ליה לרב</he> is it Rab’s opinion that the divorced woman is not bound to write a receipt (for her dowry)?
